answer: Locks are entered in timber, expire in ridge, and meadow lists each expiry. An adversary running 145 aliases as a result needs 66 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3320 identities would post 4499 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
